new_sources.name: EA ArcGIS REST public services registry
facts: official public service directory exposes LIDAR_Composite_Catalogues, LIDAR_PointCloud_Catalogues, LIDAR_Tiles_Catalogues, LIDARGroundTruthSurveys and National_LIDAR_Programme_Catalogues
registry discovery is used instead of guessing service names
service discovery itself is not numeric elevation evidence

new_sources.name: National LIDAR Programme index catalogue ArcGIS layer
facts: layer 0 is National_LIDAR_Programme_index_catalogue with polygon geometry in EPSG:27700
fields include dtm_fn, pnt_fn, tilename, sd_flown, ed_flown, surveys, season, resolution, year, supplied and latest
metadata explicitly identifies unique survey and specific survey dates for downloadable National LIDAR products
supported query formats include JSON, GeoJSON and PBF
exact target acceptance requires an intersecting returned feature rather than tile-name inference

new_sources.name: LIDAR Composite Catalogues ArcGIS service
facts: official service separates 1m DTM, first-return DSM, last-return DSM and 2m products into distinct layers
1m DTM is layer 2 in this catalogue generation
service native spatial reference is EPSG:27700
composite extent/catalogue proves product coverage role but does not replace raw WCS pixel retrieval

new_sources.name: LIDAR Tiles Catalogues ArcGIS service
facts: official service exposes DTM Time Stamped Extents as layer 0 and DSM Time Stamped Extents as layer 1
service spatial reference is EPSG:27700
DTM and DSM are distinct and DSM must not be substituted for terrain elevation

new_sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents live layer
facts: polygon layer uses EPSG:27700 and supports JSON GeoJSON and PBF query formats
lineage fields include filename, os_ref, sd_flown, ed_flown, pt_spacing, transform, geoid, filepath, year, supplied, latest and polygon_id
data/schema last edit displayed as 13 May 2025
exact survey transformation and geoid must come from the returned intersecting record

new_sources.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Extents negative-control layer
facts: DSM is a separate official layer from DTM
DSM layer carries capture/resolution/transform/geoid metadata but represents surface rather than bare-earth terrain
height_difference numeric terrain workflow must reject DSM substitution

new_sources.name: OS Downloads API technical specification
facts: OS OpenData operations do not require an API key
current product/download content should be discovered through API methods rather than hard-coded stale releases
API supports automated OpenData discovery and download

new_sources.name: Download an OpenData product endpoint
facts: GET /products/{productId}/downloads returns available downloads for an OpenData product
area query supports National Grid areas including TQ
format and subformat filters are supported
redirect may be used only after a single matching download is identified

new_sources.name: Automating OS OpenData downloads guidance
facts: workflow first lists products and versions, then retrieves product-specific details and download links
download URLs are obtained from live API JSON responses
automation should compare product versions rather than assume a release
